narrative: Gaunt's roll, a clove, and the left side of the mouth left out of the work. The door is still shut. No one else is in the chamber. He reaches the turn and does not invent a sea to stand under it. The clove is still between the words. The page has only what the roll has had since May.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Conned the speech alone, on the right side of the mouth.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Shown on part in Half a mouth
